strings.ui.c4p2.halves.title: The halves
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.subtitle: Card no. 0417 · sand-drying house, Karsk engine shed
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.instruction: Fit the German half to the Russian one: turn and slide until the perforation teeth interlock and the stamp closes.
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.wrong_turned: The writing is upside down. No teeth will mesh like this.
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.wrong: The teeth sit side by side, not in one another. The stamp stays two halves.
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.hint: Turn the German half until the writing is upright. Then slide it until the round stamp closes.
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.success: The teeth interlock, the stamp closes into a circle. On the left the Reich, on the right its counterpart: one card, two states, one order.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.title: House 14
strings.ui.c4p2.house.subtitle: Kolonnenstraße 14 · front building, side wing, rear building · Tuesday, 22:40
strings.ui.c4p2.house.instruction: Lead Ilse from Hanna’s flat to a place no card knows – over stairs, loft and cellar, past no watchful eye.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.note.v3: Lenz, Rolf, student, lodger. The radio plays until midnight.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.note.v2: Grabowski, Martha, widow, 1 pers. Coal card blocked.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.note.se: Kuhnert, Erwin and Frieda – window onto the courtyard.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.note.h2: Brettschneider, 1 pers., night shift at the gasworks.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.note.hk: Cellar passage, stairs to the cobbler’s.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.stop.s2: On the second landing of the side wing, Frau Pohl’s spyhole flips open. She reports reliably.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.stop.se: Down in the lodge, Frau Kuhnert sits at the window. She sees every step on the stairs.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.stop.ve: In the archway, Kuhnert is waiting for the gentlemen. Whoever comes down here walks straight into them.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.stop.flat: There is a household card for “{room}”. Whoever is found there will be on it tomorrow.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.stop.short: The route ends in “{room}”. Ilse needs a place no card knows.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.hint: On washday the loft is open, and from the cellar a stair leads into the workshop. Only one staircase passes no spyhole.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.success: Across the drying loft, down the back stairs past the empty number three, through the cellar into Pietsch’s workshop: there is no household card there. Nobody is looking for a child there tonight.
strings.ui.memories.decided.publish_now: This is where I gave Ekdahl everything – for a witness at Door East.
strings.ui.memories.decided.protect_first: This is where I kept the film. Lev, Maria and Konrad’s people first.
strings.ui.memories.echo.c4g_solve_halves: The teeth interlocked, the stamp closed. One card, two states.
strings.ui.memories.echo.c4h_solve_house: Across the loft, down the back stairs, through the cellar: a way no card knows.
